citations.quote: We do not pay for treatment of a pre-existing condition (HLTH-DEF-1.3) until the insured person has had 36 months of continuous cover.
Any condition, illness or injury that was diagnosed by a doctor, or for which the insured person received treatment or medication, within 36 months before the policy start date.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant was diagnosed with osteoarthritis in 2022 and has been on painkillers and physiotherapy since then, which falls under the definition of a pre-existing condition because it occurred within 36 months before the policy start date of 1 September 2024. The policy requires 36 months of continuous cover before pre-existing conditions are covered, and the claimant has not yet completed this period since the policy start date. Therefore, the knee replacement treatment for this pre-existing condition is excluded from coverage.
